rules.source_description: Checks that interactive elements have accessible names
Checks for potential color contrast issues
Checks for focus indicator styles
Checks that form inputs have associated labels
Checks that heading levels do not skip
Checks for proper landmark regions (main, nav, header, footer)
Checks for descriptive link text
Checks for skip-to-content link for keyboard navigation
Checks that data tables have proper headers
Checks for minimum touch target sizing hints
Checks that videos have captions or transcripts
Checks if viewport meta tag disables user zoom
Checks that articles have appropriate internal and external links based on length
Checks for malformed HTML structure issues
Estimates meta description pixel width to predict SERP truncation
Checks for duplicate meta descriptions across the site
Detects exact duplicate content across crawled pages using content hashing
Detects near-duplicate content across crawled pages using trigram similarity
Checks that headings follow proper hierarchy (h1 before h2 before h3) with no skipped levels
Checks that headings are between 10 and 70 characters
Checks that heading text is unique across the document
Detects excessive keyword repetition in content
Detects meta tags incorrectly placed in document body
Validates Content-Type header for correct MIME type and charset
Analyzes content readability using Flesch-Kincaid score
Checks the ratio of visible text content to total HTML size
Estimates title tag pixel width to predict SERP truncation
Checks if the title tag and H1 heading are identical (should differ for keyword variety)
Checks content length for thin content issues
Checks if multiple canonical URLs are specified via HTML and HTTP header pointing to different URLs
Detects mismatch between HTML canonical tag and HTTP Link header
Checks if canonical URL protocol mismatches the page protocol (HTTP vs HTTPS)
Checks if canonical URL may create a loop (non-self-referencing canonical)
Checks that a <link rel="canonical"> tag exists in the document
Checks if a non-homepage has its canonical URL pointing to the homepage
Checks if a page has both noindex and a canonical pointing to a different URL (conflicting signals)
Checks that the canonical URL is a valid absolute URL
Checks that the meta description is between 120 and 160 characters
Checks that a <link rel="icon"> or <link rel="shortcut icon"> tag exists
Checks that at least one <h1> tag exists in the document
Checks that only one <h1> tag exists in the document
Detects pages preventing search engine snippets
Checks robots meta tag for indexing directives
Checks that the title tag is between 30 and 60 characters
Checks that a <title> tag exists in the document head
Checks that page titles are unique across the site
Checks that a <meta name="viewport"> tag exists in the document
Checks if robots.txt blocks important CSS/JS resources
Checks that canonical URLs do not redirect
Checks for Crawl-delay directive in robots.txt
Detects conflicts between robots.txt and noindex directives
Checks for noindexed pages listed in sitemap
Checks if pagination rel="next"/"prev" links have valid URLs
Checks that paginated pages have self-referencing canonicals
Checks if pagination creates a loop by pointing back to the current page
Checks if paginated pages have noindex directive
Checks if paginated pages are missing rel="next"/"prev" relationships
Checks if pagination follows proper sequence (next and prev are different)
Detects pages with rich result schema that are blocked from indexing
Checks that all sitemap URLs belong to the expected domain
Checks for duplicate URLs in sitemap
Checks if robots.txt references the sitemap
Checks if sitemap contains URLs not linked from any crawled page
Checks if sitemap exceeds the 50 MB uncompressed size limit
Checks if sitemap exceeds the 50,000 URL limit per file
Measures visual stability by checking how much the page layout shifts during loading
Measures perceived load speed by checking when the first content is rendered
Measures responsiveness by checking the latency of user interactions
Measures loading performance by checking when the largest content element becomes visible
Measures server response time by checking how long until the first byte is received
Checks for an about/company page with content
Checks for affiliate and sponsored content disclosures
Checks for visible author names on content pages
Checks for author credentials and expertise indicators
Checks for citations to authoritative external sources
Checks for contact page with multiple contact methods
Checks for published and modified dates on content
Checks for appropriate disclaimers on sensitive content
Checks for editorial and content policy pages
Checks for visible physical address information
Checks for privacy policy page linked from footer
Checks for terms of service page
Checks for trust badges, certifications, and social proof
Detects Your Money Your Life (YMYL) content
Checks if robots.txt blocks AI crawlers (GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, Google-Extended, Claude-Web, etc.)
Checks if the page has clear content structure for AI extraction (main area, heading hierarchy, paragraphs, structured data)
Checks if the page references an llms.txt file for AI discoverability (emerging standard)
Compares JSON-LD structured data against visible page content for consistency
Checks if the page uses semantic HTML5 elements that help AI systems understand content structure
Checks that <head> contains only valid metadata elements
Checks for lorem ipsum and other placeholder text in the page content
Checks for a <meta charset> or Content-Type meta tag in the document head
Checks that the HTML document starts with a <!DOCTYPE> declaration
Checks that the document contains at most one <meta name="description"> element
Checks that the document contains only one <head> element
Checks that the document contains at most one <title> element
Checks that <noscript> inside <head> contains only permitted elements (link, style, meta)
Checks that the HTML document size is within reasonable limits
Checks for hreflang link elements for international targeting
Checks for same language code pointing to multiple different URLs
Checks if page lang attribute matches hreflang self-reference language code
Checks if hreflang is specified via both HTML link tags and HTTP headers
Checks if hreflang annotations include self-referencing link for the current page
Checks hreflang URLs for malformed or obviously broken URLs
Checks if page has both hreflang annotations and noindex directive
Checks if hreflang annotations point to non-canonical URLs
Checks if hreflang URLs may trigger redirects (HTTP on HTTPS site)
Checks that the <html> element has a valid lang attribute
Checks that image alt text is not excessively long (over 125 characters)
Checks that all images have alt attributes for accessibility and SEO
Checks that image alt text is descriptive and not generic like "image" or "photo"
Checks for important images loaded as CSS background images (not crawlable by search engines)
Checks that all images are accessible (no 404 errors)
Checks that images have width and height attributes to prevent layout shift (CLS)
Checks for proper use of figure and figcaption elements
Checks for descriptive image filenames (not IMG_001.jpg)
Checks for large inline SVGs that bloat HTML (>5KB should be external)
Checks that images below the fold use loading="lazy" for better performance
Checks that modern image formats like WebP or AVIF are used for better compression
Validates that picture elements have required img fallback
Checks that images use srcset or picture elements for responsive design
Checks that images are not excessively large (warns if estimated >200KB)
Checks if JavaScript resources may be blocked by robots.txt
Checks if the canonical URL differs between raw HTML and rendered DOM
Checks if the meta description is modified by JavaScript execution
Checks if the H1 heading is modified by JavaScript execution
Checks if the noindex directive changes between raw HTML and rendered DOM
Checks that a canonical link tag exists in the rendered DOM after JavaScript execution
Checks if significant content is only present after JavaScript rendering
Checks that a meta description exists in the rendered DOM after JavaScript execution
Checks that an H1 heading exists in the rendered DOM after JavaScript execution
Checks if important links are only present after JavaScript rendering
Checks that a <title> tag exists in the rendered DOM after JavaScript execution
Checks if the page uses SSR or relies on client-side rendering only
Checks if the page title is modified by JavaScript execution
Checks for cookie consent mechanism presence
Checks that link anchor text is descriptive and not generic like "click here" or "read more"
Checks that internal fragment links (#id) reference existing elements on the page
Checks that all internal links return HTTP 200 status codes
Checks that pages have at least one outgoing internal link for navigation
Checks that pages are not too deep in the site hierarchy (more than 3 levels from homepage)
Checks that the page does not contain an excessive number of links
Checks that pages do not have an excessive number of external links
Checks that external links are reachable and return valid responses
Checks that HTTPS pages do not link to HTTP URLs
Checks that the page contains internal links for navigation and crawlability
Checks for empty, javascript:, or malformed link hrefs
Checks for file:// protocol links and absolute OS filesystem paths in href/src attributes
Checks for links pointing to localhost, 127.0.0.1, or common development server ports
Checks that nofollow is used appropriately on external links and user-generated content
Checks for elements using onclick handlers for navigation instead of proper href attributes
Checks that pages have incoming internal links (requires crawl mode for full detection)
Checks that internal links do not go through multiple redirects
Checks that tel: and mailto: links have valid formats
Checks for links with whitespace-only or leading/trailing whitespace in href attributes
Checks that a <meta name="description"> tag exists in the document

rules.source_description: Checks for readable font sizes on mobile devices
Checks for elements that may cause horizontal scrolling on mobile
Detects potentially intrusive mobile popups and overlays
Checks for multiple viewport meta tags which can cause confusion
Checks if viewport meta tag sets a fixed width instead of device-width
Checks if Brotli compression is used instead of gzip for better compression
Checks HTTP caching headers (cache-control, expires, etag, last-modified)
Checks CSS file count and inline CSS size for performance
Checks DOM size for performance impact (nodes, depth, children)
Checks for font loading best practices (font-display, preload)
Checks for indicators of HTTP/2 or HTTP/3 protocol support (alt-svc header)
Checks total inline JavaScript size across all <script> tags
Detects lazy loading on above-fold images that should load immediately
Checks for Largest Contentful Paint optimization (preload, fetchpriority)
Checks if inline CSS in <style> tags appears to be minified
Checks if inline JavaScript in <script> tags appears to be minified
Checks HTML document size against recommended thresholds
Checks for preconnect hints to critical third-party origins
Checks for render-blocking CSS and JavaScript in the head
Checks page response time against performance thresholds
Checks if the response uses text compression (gzip, br, deflate, zstd)
Checks if page uses GIF images that should be replaced with video or WebP
Checks that redirect chains resolve to a valid (200) page
Checks that URLs are properly normalized by case to avoid duplicate content
Checks for the non-standard Refresh HTTP header that should use 301/302 status codes
Checks for JavaScript-based redirects that search engines may not follow
Checks that the redirect chain does not contain loops
Checks for meta refresh redirects that should use server-side 301 redirects
Checks that HTTPS pages do not reference HTTP resources that cause redirect chains
Checks that redirects use permanent (301/308) status codes for SEO
Validates Article, NewsArticle, BlogPosting, TechArticle, and ScholarlyArticle schemas for required and recommended fields
Validates BreadcrumbList schema presence on non-homepage pages and checks for proper itemListElement structure
Validates FAQPage schema for proper Question and Answer structure with required fields
Validates LocalBusiness, Restaurant, Store, and other local business schemas for required and recommended fields
Validates Organization schema for brand knowledge panel eligibility
Checks that JSON-LD or microdata structured data exists on the page
Validates Product schema for e-commerce rich results
Checks that JSON-LD structured data includes required fields based on @type
Validates Review and AggregateRating schema for star ratings
Checks that JSON-LD structured data includes the required @type field
Checks that all JSON-LD scripts contain valid, parseable JSON
Validates VideoObject schema for video rich results
Checks for WebSite schema with sitelinks searchbox eligibility
Checks that Content-Security-Policy header is present
Checks external target="_blank" links for noopener and noreferrer
Checks that form actions use HTTPS
Checks that Strict-Transport-Security header is present with appropriate settings
Checks that the page is served over HTTPS
Checks that HTTP requests redirect to HTTPS
Detects exposed API keys, credentials, and secrets in HTML/JS
Checks for HTTP resources on HTTPS pages
Checks if password inputs are served over insecure HTTP
Checks for Permissions-Policy header
Checks for protocol-relative URLs (starting with //) in resource references
Checks for Referrer-Policy header
Checks SSL health indicators via HSTS max-age as a proxy for certificate maintenance
Checks TLS configuration quality through HSTS directives and security header indicators
Checks that X-Content-Type-Options is set to nosniff to prevent MIME type sniffing
Checks that X-Frame-Options header is set to DENY or SAMEORIGIN to prevent clickjacking
Checks that a <meta property="og:description"> tag exists in the document
Checks that a <meta property="og:image"> tag exists with a valid URL
Checks that og:image has recommended dimensions (1200x630) via og:image:width and og:image:height meta tags
Checks that a <meta property="og:title"> tag exists in the document
Checks that a <meta property="og:url"> tag exists with a valid URL
Checks that og:url matches the canonical URL for consistent SEO signals
Checks for links to social media profiles in header, footer, or structured data
Checks for social sharing buttons on content pages to encourage social engagement
Checks that a <meta name="twitter:card"> tag exists with a valid card type
Checks that the site has a custom 404 page (not a default server error)
Checks for 4xx client errors other than 404 (e.g., 401, 403, 410, 429)
Checks that the Content-Type header is correct for an HTML page
Checks that the site has a robots.txt file accessible at /robots.txt
Checks that robots.txt file has valid syntax with User-agent and Allow/Disallow directives
Checks if the page returns a 5xx server error status code
Checks that a sitemap.xml exists at /sitemap.xml or is referenced in robots.txt
Checks that the sitemap has valid XML structure with proper elements
Detects pages that return HTTP 200 but display error page content (soft 404)
Checks if the page response time is excessive, indicating a near-timeout condition
Checks for consistent trailing slash usage across internal links
Checks that URL uses hyphens (not underscores), is lowercase, and has reasonable length
Checks that www and non-www versions redirect to one canonical version
Checks for double slashes in the URL path which indicate malformed URLs
Checks if the canonical URL uses a different protocol (HTTP vs HTTPS) than the page URL
Checks if the URL appears to be an internal search results page that should be noindexed
Checks if the full URL length is within recommended limits for SEO
Checks for non-ASCII characters in the URL path that may cause encoding issues
Checks for excessive query parameters that can fragment crawl budget and dilute page authority
Checks for consecutive duplicate segments in the URL path (e.g., /blog/blog/)
Checks for session identifiers in the URL that cause duplicate content and security issues
Checks if URL slug contains relevant keywords rather than generic identifiers
Checks for encoded spaces (%20) or literal spaces in the URL
Flags common stop words (a, an, the, of, etc.) in URL slugs that add length without SEO value
Checks for common tracking parameters (UTM, gclid, fbclid, etc.) that create duplicate URL variations
Checks if URL path uses underscores instead of hyphens; Google recommends hyphens as word separators
Checks if URL path contains uppercase letters which can cause duplicate content issues
